title: Why Would Birds Fly in a V Shape?
description: A fun and magical story where Lavanya, a curious 8-year-old Indian girl, learns from her Grandpa why birds fly together in a V shape. Blending wisdom, humor, and a touch of imagination, this story makes science feel like magic.

scenes.description: wide shot of Lavanya looking up at the evening sky, pointing at flying birds

scenes.narration: One calm evening, Lavanya looked up at the glowing sky and gasped. A group of birds flew past her house—but not randomly! They were flying in a perfect V shape. ‘Grandpa, why do they do that?’ she asked curiously.
scenes.subtitle: The Flying Question
scenes.motion_prompt: girl pointing up, birds gliding in V shape

scenes.description: medium shot of Grandpa sitting on a wooden chair under a tree, explaining

scenes.negative_prompt: blurry, scary, distorted, extra limbs, romantic
scenes.narration: Grandpa chuckled and said, ‘Ah, my dear, birds are very smart travelers. They fly in a V so that each bird helps the other. The front bird cuts the air, and the ones behind save energy!’
scenes.subtitle: Grandpa’s Wisdom

scenes.narration: ‘So that’s why they look like a flying arrow!’ Lavanya laughed, her eyes wide with wonder. Grandpa nodded, ‘Yes, my little one, flying together makes them stronger and faster—just like a good family.’
scenes.subtitle: The Big Realization

scenes.description: wide shot of birds flying away in glowing sky, Lavanya waving happily

scenes.narration: As the birds disappeared into the horizon, Lavanya waved goodbye with a big smile. She whispered, ‘Teamwork makes the dream fly!’ Grandpa chuckled again, ‘Indeed! Nature always has the best lessons.’
scenes.subtitle: The Lesson in the Sky
